 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Special Case No. 96 of 2021 arising out of Ghasipura P.S. Case No.220 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Keonjhar for offences punishable under sections 363/376(2)(n)/376(3)/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Keonjhar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Keonjhar vide order dated 28.03.2022.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Keonjhar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: // 2 // In view of the evidence of the victim, who is a minor girl examined as P.W.1 in the learned trial Court and she supported the prosecution case, while not inclining to release the petitioner on bail, I direct the learned trial Court to expedite the trial and conclude the same by the end of December 2023.
The petitioner is at liberty to renew the prayer for bail if the trial is not concluded within the aforesaid period.
